source_clock_binding: Historical833.333ps quarter versus candidate actual serial1111.111ps contract; exact forwarded-root correspondence requested from hbm_clock_boundary, unqualified until supplied.

historical_833ps.authority: W16 compare coherent roots against registered gather cuts before route selection
historical_833ps.measured_basis: C1 79315a431 existing CTS max path acc_0_8[471] to acc_0_7[471], estimated parasitics, TT overlay

coherent_spine.scope: PHYSICAL ENVELOPE, not numeric HC or a token-path implementation
coherent_spine.clock_mapping: south gather clk2, north gather clk6; source/arithmetic clocks unchanged
coherent_spine.clock_buffer_area: must be measured by CTS; no zero-cost clock claim
coherent_spine.clock_insertion_latency: CTS measured, not fixed at zero or assumed equal to old banks
coherent_spine.macro_capture_budget: real pin-registered lane clk-to-Q plus phase/skew and setup/hold; PENDING
coherent_spine.face_budget: unchanged actual die I/O delays and 60/25ps signoff uncertainty; PENDING qualification
coherent_spine.macs_per_cycle: unchanged real C1 lanes; quarter mapping is not an arithmetic workload
coherent_spine.token_latency_change: 0 added pipeline stages; phase-sensitive edge alignment and production composition unqualified
coherent_spine.routing_fit: existing data topology; clock buffer/spine competition must be measured
coherent_spine.physical_status: UNQUALIFIED; TT>=0 FF>=0 DRC0 required, SS sensitivity reported
coherent_spine.actual_producer_contract: unavailable for this envelope; phase-varied mapping gate is scoped evidence

historical_833ps.coherent_limit: This budget assumes zero gather skew at the chosen period. Real CTS skew, hold-repair/wire delay and macro capture are still unqualified; no guaranteed closure.

plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.location: 512-bit relay between acc_0_8 and acc_0_7, not cuts at every bank
plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.relay_clock: existing source root clk0; acc_0_7 retains clk1. No clock exceptions.
plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.example_limit: Equal split is analytical, not a measurement; each leg includes a new clk-to-Q and actual placement RC. Required +15ps margin on both real legs, including hold.
plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.golden_alignment: Delay all 34-bit lane outputs (data/valid/fault) entering groups7..0 of south chain by one edge; delay opposite half final512b by one edge. Mirrored cut delays both half downstream contributions instead of padding one head.
plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.other_paths: Other bank crossings and macro capture paths remain. Plain limiter cut may not be sufficient for whole-quarter closure.
plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.native_frame_contract: unavailable; this describes mathematical full-frame alignment only, not a qualified native producer or arithmetic stream proof
plain_one_edge_limiter_cut.RTL_status: not written; compare against preserved coherent candidate before selection

registered_cuts.cut_register_area: 3072 real mapped FF minimum; area from actual library required before RTL selection
registered_cuts.ordinary_one_edge_cut: Each leg remains single-cycle; no guaranteed margin from register count alone. Actual placement and inherited skew must be budgeted.
registered_cuts.two_edge_transport_requirement: A real registered hold/enable captures on the second edge, producer held stable, and all same-frame lane partials delayed together. Not implemented or supplied by current folded envelope.
registered_cuts.single_extra_edge_claim: Three bank crossings per half, so minimum +3 chain edges; +1 total is unsupported for this topology.
registered_cuts.native_frame_and_lane_alignment: unbound; extra FIFO/alignment state cannot be omitted from a production model
registered_cuts.hold_margin: actual FF capture checks still required; setup slack does not prove hold

historical_833ps.selection: No production selection or route authorization from this comparison. Coherent candidate gate preserved; source review must choose experiment with explicit remaining budgets.
historical_833ps.token_composition: Neither physical envelope has a native token/frame producer; no token-rate gain credit.
